name: Ring of the Lamb
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of the ram. Once worn, however, the wearer suffers a -4 penalty to his strength and a -15 penalty to his CMB.

Casting bull’s strength and remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, rendering the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the ram

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
